About Me

Designing for
People, First.

I'm an aspiring UI/UX Designer from Thirubuvanam, Kumbakonam, Tamil Nadu — passionate about creating digital experiences that feel effortless. With hands-on experience in Figma and Framer, I turn ideas into beautiful, functional products.
